data.title: HRH the Crown Prince Congratulates Sultan of Oman on National Day
data.content:
Riyadh, November 20, 2026, SPA -- His Royal Highness Prince Mohammed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, Crown Prince and Prime Minister, has sent a cable of congratulations to Sultan Haitham bin Tarik of Oman on his country's National Day.
    HRH the Crown Prince wished the sultan continued good health and happiness, and the government and people of Oman steady progress and prosperity.
    -- SPA
11:57 Local Time 08:57 GMT
